facts.fact: Executive Director Dr Arnold Kavaarpuo spoke for the Data Protection Commission, which he said had intensified compliance monitoring and enforcement and designated 2026 its year of enforcement.

GHA.note: No named ruling or figures stated.

facts.fact: Dr Kavaarpuo said the Data Protection Act, 2012 (Act 843) sets duties for organisations and the Commission is ensuring compliance with it.
The Data Protection Commission, led by Executive Director Dr Arnold Kavaarpuo, briefed the press on its enforcement of Act 843.
